sync.git_missing: Git is not installed, so this workspace is plain files on this computer: no history, no audit log, no way to revert a change, and no sync. Install Git, then check again.
sync.git_footer: Nothing is lost: once Git is there, the workspace becomes a repository and everything in it can be synced at once.
account.title: GitHub account
account.bound_description: The account this workspace commits and syncs as. It belongs to this workspace only.
account.unbound_description: Commits are made as this computer. An account is chosen when the workspace is published.
account.paused: Sync is paused until @{login} signs in again.
owner.title: Owner
owner.team_description: The account that owns the workspace's repository. Whoever it gives the workspace to in the Bifurc Console can import it, and sync it if they were given write access.
owner.description: The account that owns the workspace's repository. Only the owner can import it or sync it.
access.title: Access
access.read_only_description: Your account may read the repository and not push to it. What it gets is pulled, and what you change is saved on this device only. Access is checked again every few minutes, and whenever you pull.
access.read_write_description: Your account was given write access to the repository, so the workspace syncs both ways.
remote.title: Remote
remote.not_published: Not published. The workspace is on this computer only.
remote.publish_footer: Publishing creates a new repository on your account and pushes this workspace to it. Once set, the repository can't be changed.
remote.repository_description: Set once, when the workspace was published or imported. It can't be changed.
remote.footer: What the repository gets from elsewhere is pulled every few seconds, and your unsynced changes stay on top of it. Nothing of yours is pushed until you sync it.
status.title: Status
changes.title: Changes
changes.saved_here_one: 1 change is saved on this device only.
changes.saved_here_other: {count} changes are saved on this device only.
changes.committed: Everything is committed. Commits are waiting to be pushed.
changes.deleted_read_only_one: 1 deletion can be reverted where it was deleted.
changes.deleted_read_only_other: {count} deletions can be reverted where it was deleted.
changes.deleted_waiting_one: 1 deletion waits to be confirmed or reverted where it was deleted.
changes.deleted_waiting_other: {count} deletions wait to be confirmed or reverted where it was deleted.
changes.footer_read_only: This workspace is read-only: your account has read access to its repository. Ask the owner for write access to sync what you change.
changes.footer_remote: Each new or changed item gets a commit of its own, then all of them are pushed together.
changes.footer_local: Each new or changed item gets a commit of its own. Nothing leaves this computer until the workspace is published.
transfer.export_footer: Writes a Bifurc JSON file you choose the place of. Nothing in the workspace changes.
transfer.when_exists_description: What to do with an item whose id is already in the workspace.
transfer.import_footer: Imported items are added to this workspace. Requests of other tools become requests of their type: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket and the rest.
delete.title: Delete workspace “{name}”?
delete.consequence: Its requests, mocks, mappings and history are deleted from this computer. This can't be undone.
cookies.clear_on_restart: Clear cookies when the engine restarts
cookies.clear_on_restart_description: Requests keep the cookies a server sets and send them back to the same site, as a browser does: a login is followed by the requests after it, a logout ends it. Turned off, the cookies are also kept on this computer and survive a restart.
cookies.none: No cookies are stored for this workspace.
danger.description: Removes the workspace and everything in it from this computer.
danger.footer: The last workspace can't be deleted. Remote data, if connected, is not touched.
